# deps: tools: up octosql to v0.8.1

Pin `octosql` at v0.8.1 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-339]] (v0.8.0). OctoSQL is the SQL-over-anything CLI ([[DOT-96]]); the upgrade is a change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), with the `replace` directives of [[DOT-311]] to keep in step. The release notes are the [v0.8.1 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.8.1).
